label: bug
description: A defect report: something in Rune behaves incorrectly, crashes, panics, or produces a wrong result.

label: feature
description: A feature request: a proposal to add new functionality, syntax, or an API to Rune.

label: question
description: A question asking how to do something with Rune, or asking for help or clarification.

label: documentation
description: A documentation issue: missing, unclear, or incorrect documentation, examples, or comments.

label: performance
description: A performance issue: Rune is slow, uses too much memory, or compiles or runs inefficiently.
